'''2000 North American Continental Championship Yannick Lapointe GenCon winner DS deck''' is the [[Dark]] constructed list [[Yannick Lapointe]] posted on DeckTech after finishing 1st at [[2000 North American Continental Championship]]. Posted as 'GenCon winner DS deck' (15 August 2000); the description calls it 'a BHBM crap deck that can win if you play it well' and the strategy says 'THIS DECK = SHIT I GOT A BETTER VERSION NOW BUT IT WILL BE KEEP SECRET'. Lapointe won the 2000 North American Continental Championship (GenCon, 11–13 August 2000); the post gives no record.<ref name="dt-9503">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9503 GenCon winner DS deck], DeckTech (Yannick "Crusher" Lapointe, 15 August 2000). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/9503/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/9503/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261018134535/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/9503/ Wayback Machine].</ref>
